name: mpdoutput
description: MPD HTTP and Icecast streaming output for Volumio
author: Balbuze, Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: HTTP stream from the player and Icecast publishing through a relay that survives server reboots and network cuts. The stream title is what the player shows.
volumio_info.changelog: 3.0.0 - Icecast via resilient relay (no more frozen playback), settings through Volumio's MPD config, on-screen title in the stream, new owner.
